title: Lightly Smoky Turkish Sweetcorn Doner Kebab
description: A smoky and fluffy Turkish dish featuring sweetcorn, this crowd-pleaser is egg-free-friendly and perfect for any occasion. It is made in the form of a kebab-doner.
instructions: Preheat a large non-stick skillet or doner kebab cooker to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Gradually add the olive oil and water to the bowl, stirring with a fork until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 4 equal pieces and shape each piece into a thin log.
Thread each log onto a skewer or doner kebab spit, if using.
Brush the sweetcorn with a little bit of oil and season with doner kebab seasoning.
Add the sweetcorn to the skillet or doner kebab cooker and cook for 5 minutes, turning frequently.
Add the dough logs to the skillet or doner kebab cooker and cook for 10-12 minutes, turning frequently, until the dough is lightly browned and cooked through.
Serve the doner kebab hot, sliced into thin strips, with the smoky sweetcorn on the side.
